chunks: They say, 'We believe in God and the Prophet,' and 'We obey,' yet a section of them turns back even after this; and these are not believers.
ai.seo_question: What distinguishes the hypocrites' verbal faith from true belief in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between mere verbal profession (qawl) and inner conviction (yaqin), illustrating how the hypocrites (munafiqun) of Medina would declare allegiance to the Prophet but revert to their tribal loyalties upon his departure or in times of trial. The phrase 'a faction among them' is often interpreted to include the prominent figures who contested the authority of Imam Ali (AS), underscoring that true faith requires consistency between word and deed. This serves as a practical criterion for evaluating the sincerity of the community's leadership and members.
